eraId.description: must reference an existing era id (ContentLint dangling-ref check)

requiresTechId.description: must reference an existing tech id, whose era is <= this unit's era (ContentLint reachability check)

garrisonBonusPercent.description: strength bonus %, additive to 100, while garrisoned

raidBonusPercent.description: strength bonus % attacking an enemy settlement

siegeBonusPercent.description: strength bonus % attacking a garrisoned settlement

openFieldPenaltyPercent.description: strength bonus/penalty % fighting another unit in the open

vision.description: hexes the unit sees around itself (default 2)

role.description: scouts explore and can never attack (default military)
